# `user.self.delete`

Delete your account

Session-only with fresh auth and a current If-Match entity tag. Refuses the last active admin.

- Method and path: `POST /settings/delete`
- Scope: `repo:read`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie user self delete`
- MCP: `user_self_delete`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |
| `If-Match` | header | no | `string` |

## Errors

`conflict`, `precondition-required`, `stale`, `unauthorized`, plus the framework problems.
